title: Remove a package and its dependencies with paru
summary: Uninstall a package, remove its configuration files, and clean up dependencies that are no longer required by other packages.

steps.explain: Remove the specified package, its configuration files (-n), and dependencies that are not needed by other packages (-s).

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the package to remove.

rollback.explain: Reinstall the package if you removed it by mistake.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the package to reinstall.

warnings: Removing configuration files (-n) is permanent. If you plan to reinstall the package later, you might want to back up your configuration files first.
The -s flag removes dependencies. Ensure no other important software relies on them.
